business_profile: AI-led semiconductor growth with a recurring infrastructure-software cash-flow business
investment_lens: Quality-growth analysis with GARP price discipline; quality constrained by customer concentration and acquisition accounting
reason: An explicit AI/non-AI/software FCFF model represents the changing mix better than the historical-average policy screen. Selection follows business economics, not whichever style label gives the highest value. Central assumptions remain provisional because long-run AI margins and cash taxes are not independently established.

evidence.finding: AI growth and near-term guidance require a distinct AI operating forecast.
Software profitability and rising end-customer concentration require separate treatment of margins and execution risk.

distinction: Business profile determines model suitability. Investment lens does not set growth or margins. Valuation is conditional on the explicit operating forecast; the policy result is a separate investment screen. GARP is a price discipline, not an intrinsic company category.
